---
title: "About"
---

This website is a student project that explores the possibilities of graphing using ggplot2 in rstudio. The data used was sourced from the "Dutch Textile Trade" digital project. You can visit the project [here](https://dutchtextiletrade.org/).

It is titled "material study" as a reference to the data covering textile history, as well as a reference to exploring the possibilities and limitations of a medium.

This is an ongoing project that will incorporate new data sets and methodologies in the future.
